products.title: PROMAPAINT-SC3
products.description: Water-based intumescent coating for the protection of steel structures
products.fullDescription:
PROMAPAINT-SC3 is a water-based intumescent coating for the fire protection of steel structures. In case of fire the coating expands and forms an insulating layer that slows the heating of the steel and preserves the load-bearing capacity of the structure.

Advantages:
- Thin application layers
- For interior use
- Machine (airless) or manual application
- Option of a decorative top coat

products.title: PROMAPAINT-SC4
products.description: Intumescent coating for steel structures with enhanced performance
products.fullDescription:
PROMAPAINT-SC4 is a water-based intumescent coating designed for the protection of open and hollow steel sections. It is characterised by efficient consumption and reliable performance confirmed by European testing.

Advantages:
- Efficient consumption per m²
- For open and hollow sections
- Fast drying between coats
- Compatible with standard primers

products.title: HENSOTHERM 410 KS
products.description: Intumescent coating for steel — interior use
products.fullDescription:
HENSOTHERM 410 KS is a German intumescent coating for the fire protection of steel structures in interior spaces. It is part of the complete Hensel system of primers and top coats.

Advantages:
- Reliable system from a German manufacturer
- Economical protection R 30 – R 60
- Easy film thickness control
- Many years of proven references

products.title: HENSOTHERM 421 KS
products.description: High-efficiency intumescent coating for steel
products.fullDescription:
HENSOTHERM 421 KS is an intumescent coating for the protection of steel structures in interior spaces, intended for positions where an optimal ratio of layer thickness to achieved fire resistance is required.

Advantages:
- High efficiency per coat
- Interior use
- Part of the certified Hensel system
- Suitable for exposed structures

products.title: HENSOMASTIK 5 KS
products.description: Fire protection coating and sealant for cables and firestopping
products.fullDescription:
HENSOMASTIK 5 KS is a fire protection coating for cables and an integral part of soft firestopping systems (mineral wool + coating). It is applied to cable routes and the edges of seals to prevent the spread of fire.

Advantages:
- For soft seals and cable coatings
- Elastic after drying
- Applied by brush or spray
- Certified part of the Hensel firestopping system

products.title: PROMASTOP-FC
products.description: Fire protection pipe collar for combustible pipes
products.fullDescription:
PROMASTOP-FC is a fire protection pipe collar for sealing penetrations of combustible (plastic) pipes. In a fire the intumescent insert expands and closes the opening created by the melting pipe.

Advantages:
- Fast and simple installation
- For walls and ceilings
- Wide range of pipe diameters
- Certified according to EN 1366-3

products.title: PROMASTOP-U UniCollar
products.description: Universal fire protection pipe collar in strip form — cut as much as you need
products.fullDescription:
PROMASTOP-U UniCollar is a universal fire protection pipe collar in strip form that is cut to the required length on site, so one product covers all pipe diameters.

Advantages:
- One product for all diameters
- No waste — cut as needed
- Fast installation with steel clips
- Ideal for service and retrofit works

products.title: PROMASEAL-A
products.description: Fire protection sealant for joints and smaller penetrations
products.fullDescription:
PROMASEAL-A is an acrylic fire protection sealant for sealing joints, connections and smaller service penetrations. After drying it remains permanently elastic and can be painted over.

Advantages:
- Simple application with a cartridge
- Permanently elastic
- Can be painted over
- For joints in walls and ceilings

products.title: PROMASTOP-CC
products.description: Fire protection coating for cables and cable trays
products.fullDescription:
PROMASTOP-CC is a fire protection coating applied to cables and cable trays to prevent the spread of fire along cable routes and through seals.

Advantages:
- Reduces the combustibility of cables
- Part of the soft firestopping system
- Applied by brush or spray
- White colour for easy visual inspection

products.title: PROMASTOP-L
products.description: Fire protection pillow for temporary and permanent seals
products.fullDescription:
PROMASTOP-L is a fire protection pillow for sealing cable penetrations and spare openings. It is ideal for positions with frequent changes to services, as it allows simple removal and reinstallation.

Advantages:
- Dry installation without tools
- Reusable
- Ideal for server and technical rooms
- Fast intervention when services change

products.title: PROMAFOAM-C
products.description: Fire-rated installation foam
products.fullDescription:
PROMAFOAM-C is a fire-rated polyurethane foam for sealing joints and gaps, for example around fire doors and windows and smaller openings in fire compartment walls.

Advantages:
- Applied with a foam gun
- Expands and cures quickly
- Good thermal and acoustic insulation
- For the installation of fire doors and metalwork

products.title: PROMAT K84
products.description: Fire protection adhesive for calcium silicate boards
products.fullDescription:
PROMAT K84 is a fire protection adhesive intended for bonding and sealing joints of calcium silicate boards in fire protection cladding systems.

Advantages:
- Certified part of Promat cladding systems
- High temperature resistance
- Simple application
- For joints, seams and repairs

products.title: PROMATECT-H
products.description: Calcium silicate board for the most demanding cladding
products.fullDescription:
PROMATECT-H is a high-performance, moisture-resistant calcium silicate board intended for protecting structures and building fire compartment walls in the most demanding conditions — including tunnels and exterior applications.

Applications:
- Cladding of steel structures (up to R 240)
- Cladding in tunnels and infrastructure
- Smoke extraction ducts
- Self-supporting fire compartment walls

products.title: PROMATECT-100
products.description: Lightweight board for interior cladding and partitions
products.fullDescription:
PROMATECT-100 is a lightweight fire protection board for interior applications — cladding of structures, wall partitions and ceiling membranes. It is easy to work with standard tools.

Applications:
- Fire compartment walls and wall cladding
- Ceiling membranes
- Protection of steel structures
- Cladding of service shafts

products.title: PROMATECT-200
products.description: Calcium silicate board for the protection of steel structures
products.fullDescription:
PROMATECT-200 is a calcium silicate board optimised for the dry-fit protection of steel columns and beams, with an excellent ratio of thickness, weight and achieved fire resistance.

Applications:
- Box cladding of columns and beams
- Fire compartment walls
- Protection of composite structures
- Smooth surface ready for finishing

products.title: MASTERBOARD
products.description: Universal fire-resistant building board
products.fullDescription:
MASTERBOARD is a universal non-combustible building board for a wide range of applications in fire protection and drywall construction, including areas with elevated humidity.

Applications:
- Wall and ceiling cladding
- Substrates for finishing layers
- Protection of timber and steel elements
- Non-combustible alternative to gypsum plasterboard

products.title: FSB single-leaf fire doors
products.description: Steel single-leaf fire doors from our own production
products.fullDescription:
Single-leaf fire doors from FSB's own production — our own product under the FSB Doors brand, certified according to European standards.

Characteristics:
- Steel construction with fire-resistant infill
- Fire resistance EI₂ 30 – EI₂ 90
- Standard and special made-to-measure dimensions
- Options: door closer, panic hardware, glazing, smoke seals

As a manufacturer, we offer short delivery times, adaptation to the project and installation by our own crews.

products.title: FSB double-leaf fire doors
products.description: Steel double-leaf fire doors for larger openings
products.fullDescription:
Double-leaf fire doors from FSB's own production — our own product under the FSB Doors brand — intended for larger openings: technical rooms, industrial halls, garages and escape routes.

Characteristics:
- Steel construction with high rigidity
- Fire resistance EI₂ 30 – EI₂ 90
- Door coordinator for closing sequence
- Options: panic hardware, glazing, electric strikes

The doors are certified according to European standards, including the double-leaf version.

specifications.sizes: Up to large formats, made to measure

products.title: FSB fire-rated glazed partitions
products.description: Systems of fire-rated glazed partitions and glazing
products.fullDescription:
FSB fire-rated glazed partition systems combine steel or aluminium profiles with certified fire-resistant glass, for positions where transparency is required along with full fire resistance.

Characteristics:
- Partitions and glazing EI 30 – EI 90
- Combination with FSB fire doors
- Large glazed surfaces in atriums and corridors
- Detailing, supply and installation from a single source

products.title: FSB fire-rated spandrel
products.description: Our own developed system for fire separation between floors at the façade
products.fullDescription:
The FSB fire-rated spandrel is our own developed solution for preventing the vertical spread of fire across the façade. The system of substructure, mineral wool and fire protection boards adapts to any façade geometry.

Characteristics:
- Developed by the FSB R&D team
- Tested in accredited laboratories
- Adaptation to the façade geometry
- Supply and installation by our own crews
